title: GInsights in GCash for Business
content: GInsights is a financial decision-partner concept built for GCash for Business as part of ImaGnation 2026. Its prototype turns business cash-flow information into practical guidance: a loan-risk view, a safe payment amount, break-even context, a cash calendar, and clear recommendations. The project emphasizes product thinking, approachable financial explanations, and using AI-informed guidance to support small-business decisions. The portfolio describes it as a team project by IThink; it was disqualified, but the work strengthened the team's approach to iteration and collaboration.

metadata.shortDescription: AI-informed financial guidance concept for small businesses.

title: PasyenTrack
content: PasyenTrack is a medical record management system built using C++, Qt and MySQL. It centralizes patient records and includes authentication, record search, and record management. A binary-search-tree index supports faster patient lookup. It is relevant to healthcare-adjacent software, desktop application development, database integration, and structured data handling.

metadata.shortDescription: Medical record management system with MySQL-backed patient records.
